message.content: Based on the conversations shared, LiHua finds several aspects of "Black Myth: Wukong" impressive. Specifically, he highlights the game's stunning visuals and compelling storytelling. LiHua mentions that the game offers a fresh take on the classic tale of Wukong, emphasizing that the gameplay has unique mechanics which make it enjoyable. Additionally, he notes that the story is rich and has a great atmosphere, adding to the immersive experience. Therefore, both the visual aesthetics and the narrative depth are noted as standout features of "Black Myth: Wukong."
